methodology.signal_timing: Signal uses daily closes through close t only.
methodology.selection: Choose the highest absolute fast-plus-slow move among qualifying symbols.
methodology.scoring: Score direction against underlying close t+2.
methodology.interpretation: Directional signal proxy; not executable option P&L.
methodology.sharpe_proxy: Event-level mean/stdev scaled by observed signals per calendar year; not a portfolio Sharpe ratio.
methodology.robustness: Non-overlapping holdout greedily accepts a signal only after the prior selected holding window exits.
